UPDATE `#__guidedtours` SET `autostart` = 0; INSERT INTO `#__guidedtours` (`title`, `uid`, `description`, `ordering`, `extensions`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `access`, `autostart`) VALUES ('Timed Publishing', 'joomlaguide-timed-publishing', '

An article can appear on your site, and on the home page as a featured article, at a time you choose, and disappear again at another time.

Ready for you: the featured article Merger Talks Confirmed Between Rival Tech Firms in the category World News, which has a menu item World News in the Main Menu.

First you set the time zone of the website to yours, so the times you enter are your local times.

This tour follows the tutorial 7.3 Timed Publishing of the Joomla User Guide.

', 1, '["com_cpanel","com_config","com_content"]', 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', 'Joomla User Guide: 7.3 Timed Publishing', 1, 1); INSERT INTO `#__guidedtour_steps` (`tour_id`, `title`, `description`, `ordering`, `position`, `target`, `type`, `interactive_type`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `params`) VALUES ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-timed-publishing'), 'System', '

In the menu on the left, click System.

', 1, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu a[href="index.php?option=com_cpanel&view=cpanel&dashboard=system"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-timed-publishing'), 'Setup › Global Configuration', '

In the box Setup, click Global Configuration.

', 2, 'bottom', '.com_cpanel #content a[href="index.php?option=com_config"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_cpanel&view=cpanel&dashboard=system', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-timed-publishing'), 'Server', '

Click the Server tab.

', 3, 'bottom', '.com_config button[aria-controls="page-server"]', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_config', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-timed-publishing'), 'Website Time Zone', '

Note the current Website Time Zone (normally Universal Time, Coordinated (UTC)), so you can set it back later.

Click the field, type the name of a city in your time zone, for example Amsterdam or New York, and press Enter. Then click Next.

', 4, 'top', '.com_config fieldset:has(#jform_offset)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_config', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-timed-publishing'), 'Save the configuration', '

Click Save & Close.

', 5, 'bottom', '.com_config .button-save', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_config', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-timed-publishing'), 'Content', '

In the menu on the left, click Content.

It opens and shows what you can do there.

', 6, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu li.item-level-1:has(a[href="index.php?option=com_content&view=articles"]) > a.has-arrow', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-timed-publishing'), 'Content › Articles', '

Click Articles in Content.

', 7, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu a[href="index.php?option=com_content&view=articles"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-timed-publishing'), 'The featured article', '

Merger Talks Confirmed Between Rival Tech Firms has a gold star (featured) and a green tick (published).

Look at your site (click Site in the toolbar of the Joomla Playground): the article is on the home page, and in the blog World News.

', 8, 'bottom', '#articleList tr:has([title$=" merger-talks-confirmed-between-rival-tech-firms"])', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-timed-publishing'), 'Open the article', '

Click Merger Talks Confirmed Between Rival Tech Firms to edit it.

', 9, 'right', '#articleList tr:has([title$=" merger-talks-confirmed-between-rival-tech-firms"]) a[href*="task=article.edit"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-timed-publishing'), 'Publishing', '

Click the Publishing tab.

', 10, 'bottom', '.view-article button[aria-controls="publishing"]', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-timed-publishing'), 'Set the times', '

Look at the clock and fill in four times, a few minutes apart, for example when it is now 14:00:

  • Start Publishing: 14:03
  • Start Featured: 14:05
  • Finish Featured: 14:07
  • Finish Publishing: 14:09

Type each one as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, such as 2026-04-16 14:03:00, or click the calendar button next to the field. Then click Next.

', 11, 'right', '.view-article #fieldset-publishingdata', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-timed-publishing'), 'Save the article', '

Click Save & Close.

', 12, 'bottom', '.view-article #save-group-children-save .button-save', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-timed-publishing'), 'Published, but not yet', '

The Status icon has changed: the article is published, but it waits for its Start Publishing time. The Featured icon has changed too. Hover over the icons to read what they mean.

', 13, 'right', '#articleList tr:has([title$=" merger-talks-confirmed-between-rival-tech-firms"]) .article-status', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-timed-publishing'), 'Watch the clock', '

Look at your site and reload the home page and the blog World News after each time you set:

  1. Before Start Publishing: the article is nowhere.
  2. After Start Publishing: it is in the blog, not yet on the home page.
  3. After Start Featured: it is on the home page too.
  4. After Finish Featured: it is in the blog only.
  5. After Finish Publishing: it is gone.

Reload this list too, and hover over the icons to see how they change.

Outside the Playground, set the Website Time Zone back in Global Configuration if you changed it only for this tutorial.

', 14, 'bottom', '#articleList tr:has([title$=" merger-talks-confirmed-between-rival-tech-firms"])', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL);
